title: Child Education Allowance Bill Generator
name: Child Education Allowance Bill
summary: Claim form for the reimbursement of a children education allowance.
description: Fill in the proforma for the reimbursement of a children education allowance (CEA) or hostel subsidy with the claimant, the spouse, the children and their schools and the expenditure. Preview instantly and download as PDF.
intro: A children education allowance (CEA) bill is the proforma in which an employee lists their children, their schools and the money spent, to be reimbursed under the employer's rules. It also covers a hostel subsidy and the details of the spouse.

print.intro: I hereby apply for the reimbursement of the children education allowance / hostel subsidy for my child / children, and the relevant particulars are furnished below:

print.q5: If the spouse is employed under the central / state government, an autonomous body, a government undertaking, a local body or a private organisation, etc.

print.children_title: Details of the child / children for whom the allowance / hostel subsidy is claimed:
